She can’t refuse because of her dependent position, but she is reluctant to face Kwon Hyun-jin, who reigned as the young tyrant of the house.
But his luxurious penthouse where he lived alone, but somehow it doesn’t feel warm, which makes her nervous…
Thud. A hand stretched out from behind her and rested on the table. Suddenly, she was trapped between Kwon Hyun-jin’s hands. At the same time, a sweet floral scent exploded like a bomb.
“How can I think of you as a friend when you’re so f*cking pretty!”
Kwon Hyun-jin shouted, frustrated.
“Cute, goddamn it. Adorable!”
Dumbfounded, she stared blankly at Kwon Hyun-jin with her lips parted.
At Kwon Hyun-jin, who was shouting, his face red to his neck.
“I’m going crazy because you’re so pretty, Lee Na-hee…”

148041.synopsis:
The world of an otome game? I don’t know a thing about that! I’m going to do as I please!!
Randolph, a former Japanese man, has reincarnated as a “mob” noble in a world resembling a game. One day, he ends up rescuing a noblewoman—who was supposed to have been exiled from the country—from a group of thugs. However, the soul of an ancient Great Mage ends up possessing the body of the young woman he saved…!?
Having secured her cooperation in developing his territory in exchange for helping search for the Great Mage’s original body, Randolph utilizes a rare skill he obtained to solve the issue of surplus monster materials. He makes steady progress in pioneering his land, improving farming tools and carriages using his modern knowledge, but…?

148553.synopsis:
She transmigrated and became a green snake.
Su Qing had no intention of transforming into a dragon. She knew the status dragons held in mythology — always getting the short end of the stick. Monkeys dared to bully them, Nezha dared to bully them, and dragon liver and phoenix marrow were considered delicacies.
So all she wanted was to become a powerful demon, live as a “Willow Immortal”, protect a small region of people, and enjoy a quiet life.
Fortunately, she managed to achieve all of that.
But a thousand years later, a young girl named Xuanzang smashed her mountain gate with a single punch and asked if she wanted to go fetch scriptures.
Then came some guy with a serious case of chuunibyou syndrome, constantly shouting “Great Mighty Heavenly Dragon” and bothering them every day.
Sigh. Why is it so hard to just live a peaceful life?

149833.synopsis:
[Alternate-history] [genius-type] [power-struggle] [decisive] [ruthless] [battle-driven] [hot-blooded] 
In the name of Yan and Huang, he unleashes a massacre. Borrowing the might of the Heavens, Li Xiao, a youth from the Western Regions, begins with nothing but his clan. He smelts steel on a massive scale, casts cannons, garrisons troops, raises horses, and launches campaigns of conquest in all directions.
With the Han people of the Western Regions as his foundation, he establishes the strongest army on earth in the 13th century—the Six Garrisons Iron Cavalry.
Marching east against the Mongols, he engages in a decisive battle with Temujin’s cavalry on the banks of the Onon River. Entering the passes into the Central Plains, he visits the humiliation of the Jingkang Incident back upon the Jurchens. Launching a northern expedition against the Rus principalities, he brings Siberia into the fold of Huaxia. Invading the South Asian subcontinent, the people of Bharata submit as subjects. Campaigning west into Europe, he crushes the Crusaders, waters his horses in the Rhine, and points his sword toward Britain.
Using warhorses, steel blades, and cannons, he establishes the empire with the vastest territory in human history.

154441.synopsis:
She became a green serpent, gliding through the waters by the Wei River, thinking that this life would pass in muddled obscurity.
Then, one day, someone hauled her out of the water.
The one who took her embroidered her into a totem, carried her into battle across all directions, adorning her with the traits of many tribal totems!
From that moment on, the fate of the snake was bound to this land.
Five thousand towering years!
I have seen many people, I have seen many events.
I have watched kings and ministers ascend the stage, and I have watched flowers fall, helpless against fate.
I was the foremost contributor to the fall of Shang, the teacher of the First Emperor, a guest of Emperor Wu of Han, a friend of the Crouching Dragon.
I witnessed the elegance of Wei and Jin, I beheld the grandeur of the High Tang.
I heard the many graces of the Two Song dynasties, I sighed that Yongle was not truly Yongle.
The totem raised by the Wei River is me, and the symbol of the Heaven-ordained Son will also be me!
What? You ask who I am?
My name is Qing Nu—Shaodian Qingnu.
Just a snake who longs to become a dragon.

155465.synopsis:
Bo Ting considered himself just an ordinary unemployed young man. After losing his job and sleeping in frustration at home, he woke up the next day to discover—he had transmigrated.
Not only had he transmigrated, but the entire residential complex had come with him.
Overnight, they inexplicably arrived in… a strange city?
Before he could freak out over this unscientific event, Bo Ting suffered even more bad luck—he realized not only was his education useless here, but he also seemed to have developed mental illness.
He started hallucinating that he was some bizarre thing the moment he opened his eyes, and even looking at his neighbors felt off.
#
In the midst of anomalies resurging, a residential complex with no records suddenly descended upon the southern part of Mengjia City, drawing the highest attention from the Resurgence Management Office.
The building materials of the complex could not be detected and existed between illusion and reality. Like any ordinary neighborhood, its gate bore the words 【Taiping Luxury Garden】, red couplets were posted on it, and there was a security booth at the entrance—yet no security guard ever appeared.
After multiple tests, passersby had no impression of the complex at all. Strangely, nearby anomalies all avoided approaching it.
The Resurgence Management Office treated it as a major threat. Fortunately, 【Taiping Luxury Garden】 remained silent for a month after arriving in Mengjia City. Just as they classified it as a Dormant Anomaly and lowered the alert level by one—the next second, a handsome young man in a black hoodie, with a humanoid form, walked out from the complex.
The Resurgence Management Office, who had just breathed a sigh of relief after revoking the alert: ???
Bo Ting, stepping out of the complex for the first time: ???
#
Although Bo Ting had become a mental patient, as one of the few young and strong laborers in the complex after transmigration, he was entrusted with a heavy responsibility by the residents’ committee after five days of heated discussion. He was sent out as the representative of 【Taiping Luxury Garden】 to procure supplies and send messages for everyone.
And also… *cough cough* (blushing), to meet up in person with the beautiful online friend who had frequently comforted him after the transmigration.
In Bo Ting’s mind, this netizen not only didn’t mind that he was a mental patient but patiently encouraged him to regain his confidence and embrace life. He was truly a good person.
To make him feel valued, Bo Ting specially bought a bouquet of pink roses from the flower shop at the base of the complex before the meetup. After thoughtfully writing a card, he stepped out of the complex gate with a “heart pounding with excitement.”
A few minutes later, he suddenly locked eyes with a group of people across the street and was shocked to discover—wait, why was he surrounded?!
